[1/1] Add URL-based PDF extraction and readable website article extraction: download bounded bytes, detect PDF by content type/magic/path, reuse PyPDF2 page extraction, and extract main article text from HTML with lxml while dropping navigation, scripts and boilerplate.

impact_assessment.why: NeuralDeck already reads local PDFs, but users cannot paste a PDF link or a normal article URL; raw HTML passthrough includes navigation and cookie banners.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds two common study sources without new runtime dependencies (PyPDF2 and lxml are already declared), reusing the existing card pipeline and preview.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: TranscriptResult gains pdf/web kinds; dependency: none; concurrency: URL fetch stays on the existing worker; state: downloaded bytes and extracted text stay in memory only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bound downloads, detect PDF before decoding, keep the extractor pure and fixture-tested, and fall back to the existing transcript parser when article extraction is thin.

[1/1] Let Preview Transcript extract a selected local document/PDF/transcript/audio before generation and reuse that text, instead of requiring a full LLM run first.

impact_assessment.why: The preview button is disabled for local files until generation, so extraction or transcription errors are discovered only after the user spends LLM time.
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can inspect the exact source text early; the preview extraction is cached and reused by Generate, avoiding duplicate work.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI state machine only; dependency: none; concurrency: extraction runs on a worker thread and modal preview opens on the UI thread; state: cached text stays in memory and is cleared when another file is selected.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Disable source-changing controls during preview, marshal every UI update with after(), and reuse the existing extraction dispatcher.

[1/1] Add direct video/audio URL extraction: detect media extensions, stream bounded media to a temp file, transcribe locally with faster-whisper, delete the temp file, and label video vs audio sources; extend the UI picker and tests.

impact_assessment.why: Local video files were transcribed, but direct media URLs were rejected and video containers were labeled as audio.
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can paste lecture or podcast media URLs and get cards without a separate download step; video sources are identifiable in the UI.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new media download path and TranscriptResult kinds audio/video; dependency: optional faster-whisper only at transcription time; concurrency: streaming and transcription stay on the existing worker; state: a temp media file exists during one transcription and is deleted in finally.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Cap downloads at 300 MB, stream in 1 MB chunks, reject HTML/JSON responses, clean temp files on every exit path, and mock the network/transcriber in tests.

[1/1] Replace the deprecated PyPDF2 dependency with pypdf, keeping the same PdfReader/page/extract_text behavior and updating imports, tests, requirements and docs.

impact_assessment.why: PyPDF2 emits an upstream deprecation warning and pypdf is its maintained successor; staying on it adds avoidable supply-chain and compatibility risk.
impact_assessment.benefits: Removes the deprecated dependency and warning without changing the PDF extraction contract.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: same extract_text_from_pdf/extract_text_from_pdf_bytes API; dependency: pypdf replaces PyPDF2; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use the compatible PdfReader API, update every test patch target, pin pypdf, and run the full suite plus a live PDF extraction.

[1/1] Catch http.client.IncompleteRead while streaming media so a truncated response is reported as a transcript error and the temporary file is deleted instead of leaking.

impact_assessment.why: The media download loop catches URLError/TimeoutError/OSError, but IncompleteRead is not an OSError; a broken connection could bypass cleanup.
impact_assessment.benefits: A truncated media download now gets a clear Why/Fix error and never leaves a temp file behind.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: private helper only; dependency: none; concurrency: unchanged; state: temp file cleanup.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add the explicit exception branch and a regression test using a truncated response.
